review:
A watercolour Asian adventure on 10 lines. Densho symbols expand into wild multiplier reels when they'd pass through a win.

There are three grades of Densho with different multiplier ranges, and several in one win add together. In free spins, trackers above each reel show the minimum grade that can land there – and landing Densho symbols raises it, so the bonus gets better as it goes. Rated 4/5, 10,000x max, top RTP 96.4%.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Casinos can run versions as low as 88.34% RTP
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
